description: Prepare the active repository for CodeGraph indexing when a Codex session starts.

hooks.command: ( grep -qxE '[.]codegraph[[:space:]]*' "$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude)" || { echo; echo .codegraph; } >> "$(git rev-parse --git-path info/exclude)" ) >&2
( cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npx --yes @colbymchenry/codegraph init --yes && npx --yes @colbymchenry/codegraph index ) >&2
